title: Name standalone observed-check refusals with the actual check field path
outcome: Standalone observed_check diagnostics consistently identify check.* while turn diagnostics identify observed_checks[i].*, without echoing caller values.
acceptance: For a standalone observed_check occurrence, shape, retired-source and root-basis refusals name the request's actual check.* path; unadmitted-turn refusals keep observed_checks[i].*. Behavioral tests distinguish both shapes, preserve refusal/no-write behavior and never echo host_check_id values.
